room.alt: A living room: a sofa under a framed print, a tall window on the left, a floor lamp and a potted plant on the right, a round rug on the floor.

points.title: The window
points.text: Double-glazed, south-facing. Blinds are made to measure and fitted in a morning.

points.title: Arc floor lamp
points.text: Warm 2700 K bulb on a dimmer, so the corner works for reading and for films.

points.title: Three-seat sofa
points.text: Removable, washable covers in twelve colours. Delivered and assembled in the room.

points.title: Plant and pot
points.text: A rubber plant that copes with low light, in a terracotta pot with a saucer.

points.title: Round rug
points.text: Hand-woven wool, 2 m across. It hides a draughty floorboard nobody has fixed yet.

hills.alt: Rolling hills at dusk under a purple sky, the sun low over the far ridge.

points.title: Sunset Point
points.text: The low sun sits here in late September. Arrive twenty minutes before sunset.

points.title: West ridge trail
points.text: Two miles, gentle, with benches every half mile.
